event.title: Deterministic live-width path-DP gives a second large-support exact-survival lane
statement: Live intervals derived from the frozen B2 gate trace form a valid path decomposition without any order/decomposition search.
Exact output feasibility and residual nonconstancy cost poly(T)*2^O(lambda), where lambda is maximum live-bag width.
Polynomial trace bytes plus a universal lambda=O(log N) bound imply deterministic polynomial exact-survival discovery in original N.
Parity has polynomially large support yet constant live width in its streaming representation.
A pair-fanout dependency architecture of size O(n^2) forces lambda=Omega(n) for every topological serialization of that fixed architecture, but an equivalent lower-width representation may exist.
boundaries: No universal low-live-width representation theorem is proved.
No cheap equivalent-circuit rewrite constructor is proved.
Exact survival is not yet global proof progress.
